s1.syndrome_frame: Cardiac arrest with preceding respiratory distress
salient_findings: Cardiac arrest with pulseless electrical activity as initial rhythm
Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) with shortness of breath for 2 days prior to presentation
Return of spontaneous circulation after cardiopulmonary resuscitation and epinephrine administration
key_facts: Patient is a man in his 80s
Last seen healthy by family 4 hours prior to cardiac arrest
Found unresponsive and pulseless in the bathroom
Underwent cardiopulmonary resuscitation with 4 doses of epinephrine intravenously
Endotracheal tube intubation was performed
Return of spontaneous circulation occurred after approximately 10 minutes
Patient has chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)
Patient complained of shortness of breath for 2 days prior to presentation
Family member witnessed patient struggling for air before losing consciousness
Initial rhythm was pulseless electrical activity
ECG findings include sinus rhythm at approximately 100 beats per minute, right axis deviation, and prolonged QRS duration
